task: Resolve dark mode unseeable continuation buttons in ADM and Secretary Minutes, eliminate duplicate panelist names via row consolidation (1 row per panel member with multi-bullet suggestions matching BukSU reference format), ensure screen-and-print WYSIWYG parity, and prevent duplicate row defaults.

changes.summary: Scoped dark mode paper typography overrides strictly to .secretary-minutes-page and .adm-document-page while explicitly excluding button, [role='button'], and .no-print elements, restoring full contrast to continuation buttons across dark mode canvases.

Implemented consolidateADMRowsByPanel to merge duplicate panel rows into single rows with multi-bullet suggestions and tracked merged IDs; added getNextAvailablePanelistName candidate selection to prevent repeating names when adding rows; enhanced continuation button dark classes.
Added unit tests verifying consolidateADMRowsByPanel functionality, non-repeating panelist name candidate selection, and screen-and-print WYSIWYG parity.
Added dark theme classes to continuation insertion buttons for high-contrast visibility.
Added consolidateInstitutionalADMRows in getActionDoneMatrix to ensure backend responses group existing un-consolidated rows per panel member.
Updated syncToADM in saveSecretaryMinutes to group defense remarks by panelist name, preventing duplicate panel rows upon sync.
Refined Google OAuth error handling and origin mismatch messages.
Refined Google OAuth registration flow and error handling.

playwrightVisualLoop.lightModeDesktop: verified high contrast buttons and consolidated rows
playwrightVisualLoop.darkModeDesktop: verified color rgb(24, 119, 242) primary blue text, zero black-on-black
playwrightVisualLoop.darkModeMobile: verified responsive row consolidation and contrast
